subject: BrightPeak: vendor portal onboarding + evidence presign request
messages:
From: Elena Mendez <elena@brightpeak.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPeak: evidence request & portal onboarding for SOC 2 / CAIQ

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this — BrightPeak is ready to move forward with the vendor security onboarding. We run our intake via Vendr (preferred) but can accept presigned S3 uploads if that’s easier. For the first pass we need: SOC 2 report or SOC 2 summary, CAIQ/ SIG mapping answers (spreadsheet preferred), network diagram (redacted OK), KMS rotation policy, and an asset inventory showing privileged accounts and service accounts.

I attached our questionnaire (BrightPeak-questionnaire-v0.3.xlsx) — the BrightPeak security team would like the first tranche of artifacts within 5 business days if possible because procurement needs to sign the mutual action plan. Are you able to (a) confirm the upload mechanism and (b) assign an internal owner for evidence uploads?

A few notes from our side: we prefer a single bucket with a manifest CSV and presigned PUTs for each file (we’ll give a single point-of-contact for upload). Also: we need an owner for the privileged-asset inventory because we do an automated reconciliation.

Thanks,
Elena Mendez
Security Program Manager
BrightPeak

Attachment: BrightPeak-questionnaire-v0.3.xlsx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mendez <elena@brightpeak.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPeak: evidence request & portal onboarding for SOC 2 / CAIQ

Hi Elena — great to meet you over email. Thank you for the questionnaire and the clear ask. Quick answers:

- Upload mechanism: we can do Vendr profile + presigned S3 manifests. For speed I recommend presigned PUTs to a short-lived staging bucket and a manifest CSV. Marissa will generate the presign manifest and a single upload link.
- Internal owner: assigning Jonas to lead the CAIQ mapping and I’ll own the privileged-asset inventory reconciliation.

Timeline proposal:
1) Today (Nov 10): Marissa creates presign manifest & shared link.
2) Nov 11–12: BrightPeak uploads artifacts to presigned bucket.
3) Nov 15: Jonas completes CAIQ mapping review and flags gaps.

Two clarifying asks from our side: can you mark which items are non-production (e.g., demo test accounts) so we can exclude them from the privileged-asset reconciliation? Also, if the SOC 2 you have is a full report vs. an internal summary, please indicate redaction needs for third-party names.

I’ll loop internally on next steps.

-Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Security & Risk, Redwood Inference

PS: forwarding the questionnaire to Marissa & Jonas so they have context.

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BrightPeak vendor onboarding — presign + privileged-asset owner

Marissa / Jonas —

Quick internal kickoff: BrightPeak (deal DP-4892) sent the attached questionnaire and asked for a presigned upload path. I propose:
- Marissa: generate a single presign bundle and manifest CSV (file names, expected SHA256 optional, target folder structure = /brightpeak/DP-4892/). Please mark the bucket TTL at 7 days.
- Jonas: once artifacts are uploaded, run the CAIQ mapping and provide an exceptions list (we should scope out non-prod accounts and ephemeral credentials).

A couple gotchas to call out: BrightPeak expects privileged-asset mapping (they match service accounts to customer-facing infra). We should be explicit about what we include in the inventory (service accounts with elevated IAM, API keys, and any on-call escalation jump boxes). If needed, we can redact internal email addresses in the network diagram.

Related: procurement wants the M.A.P. timeline aligned with uploads — I’ll keep the buyer looped.

Thanks — please ack and post the presign link into the thread so I can share with Elena.

-Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BrightPeak vendor onboarding — presign + privileged-asset owner

Ack — creating presign now. Attached is the manifest template (presign_manifest.csv). I set the bucket TTL to 7 days and prefixed files under /brightpeak/DP-4892/. Notes: please advise on whether we want to include hashed passwords vs. credential names — my recommendation is NO plaintext secrets (obvious), and to include only the service account identifier + role. For the network diagram, we’ll ask BrightPeak to redact third-party customer names; we can provide an annotated version after review.

I’ll post single presign link below when ready.

Attachment: presign_manifest.csv

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Vendor Security Operations, Redwood Inference
